run_render_train_imgs: run the render_train_imgs.py script to render RGB-D training images for BOP datasets like tyol or tless
render_rgb_depth_images: render RGB and depth images of 3D object models from sampled viewpoints using the vispy renderer
sample_views_hinterstoisser: sample viewpoints on a view sphere using the hinterstoisser method for a given radius and minimum view count
save_scene_camera_gt: save scene camera intrinsics and ground truth pose metadata as JSON for each rendered object
resize_rgb_ssaa: downsample super-sampled RGB images to target resolution using OpenCV INTER_AREA interpolation
